subject: Pedestrian and Bicycle Safety
overview: The committee met to discuss pedestrian and bicycle safety following two recent traffic fatalities in Medford. Members reviewed safety plans for state-controlled rotaries and discussed infrastructure and budget recommendations with the Medford Bicycle Advisory Commission.

items.title: Pedestrian and Bicycle Safety (Paper 25-037)
items.summary: Kept the matter in committee after discussing safety priorities, upcoming state-funded rotary realignments, and municipal budget requests with members of the Medford Bicycle Advisory Commission.
